import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = ['PhD', 'Graduation', 'Master', '2n Cycle', 'Basic']
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Income'])
sns.boxplot(data=df_clean, y='Education', x='Income', ax=ax1, order=education_order)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Education', fontsize=9)

# 2. Total Spending by Product Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
total_spending = df[spending_cols].sum()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(spending_cols))
ax2.bar(range(len(spending_cols)), total_spending.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(spending_cols)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold'], 
                     rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=9)

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
current_year = 2014
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax3.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)

# 4. Purchase Channels Comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 
                     'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_totals = df[purchase_channels].sum()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A']
ax4.pie(channel_totals.values, labels=['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals'], 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)

# 5. Marital Status Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(marital_counts))
ax5.barh(marital_counts.index, marital_counts.values, color=colors)
ax5.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Marital Status', fontsize=9)

# 6. Income vs Total Spending Scatter
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=9)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=8)

# 7. Campaign Acceptance Rates
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 
                 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = df[campaign_cols].mean() * 100
colors = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(campaign_cols))
ax7.bar(range(len(campaign_cols)), acceptance_rates.values, color=colors)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(campaign_cols)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response'], 
                    fontsize=8)
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=9)
ax7.axhline(y=acceptance_rates.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            linewidth=1, alpha=0.7, label='Average')
ax7.legend(fontsize=8)

# 8. Kids at Home Impact on Spending
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax8.plot(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='coral')
ax8.set_title('Average Spending by Number of Kids', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_xlabel('Total Kids at Home', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Spending ($)', fontsize=9)
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 9. Recency Distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.hist(df['Recency'], bins=30, color='mediumseagreen', 
         edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_title('Customer Recency Distribution', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase', fontsize=9)
ax9.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=9)
ax9.axvline(x=df['Recency'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {df["Recency"].median():.0f}')
ax9.legend(fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Campaign Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
